profile.summary: NVIDIA Corporation operates as a data center scale AI infrastructure company in the United States, Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Compute & Networking, and Graphics segments. The Compute & Networking segment provides data center accelerated computing and networking platforms and artificial intelligence solutions and software, and automotive platforms and autonomous and electric vehicle solutions, including software. The Graphics segment offers GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs; Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics. The company's products are used in gaming, professional visualization, data center, and automotive markets. It sells its products to original equipment manufacturers, original device manufacturers, system integrators and distributors, independent software vendors, cloud service providers, add-in board manufacturers, distributors, automotive manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers, and other ecosystem participants. It has a collaboration with Cisco to develop Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a high-density optical module pluggable transceiver. It has a collaboration with ChipAgents to develop Build-A-Chip-Bench, a benchmark for AI agents carrying chip design tasks and The Company has a strategic alliance with MediaTek to build the next generations of AI computing platforms. NVIDIA Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

news.title: Anthropic IPO reportedly 6 times oversubscribed
news.summary: "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the upcoming IPO of Anthropic (ANTH.PVT). According to Bloomberg, the offering is already six times oversubscribed, signaling strong demand for shares of the artificial intelligence company ahead of its public market debut.

news.title: Nvidia stock slips as investors digest CEO exit, broader chip sell-off accelerates
news.summary: Nvidia stock declined on Friday as the rest of the chip sector also fell.

news.title: Inflation that won't die could be 2027's economic shock
news.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi asserts persistent inflation could be next year's economic shock – recalling his conversation with Chicago Federal Reserve President Austin Goolsbee – and does not rule out a 50 basis point rate hike in December.

news.title: The road ahead without Jensen Huang: Who can run Nvidia?
news.summary: In the wake of Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia, Unconventional AI CEO Naveen Rao weighs in on internal and external CEO candidates like Ian Buck and Rene Haas, and warns that the wrong pick could threaten the open-source AI ecosystem Nvidia has backstopped. news.title: What the Nvidia scandal means for the company's earnings next week
news.summary: Nvidia's earnings come a week after now-former CEO Jensen Huang's affair scandals rocked the company and tech world.

news.title: What investors should consider before hitting buy on Nvidia
news.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi lays out guideposts he wants to see before buying Nvidia (NVDA) stock, including a CEO hire and results from the company's upcoming earnings report.

news.title: Ex-Medtronic CEO grades Nvidia board: 'About an F'
news.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi is joined by former Medtronic (MDT) CEO Bill George, who grades the Nvidia (NVDA) board's makeup, its handling of Jensen Huang's departure, and its succession plan.

news.title: What AI CEOs expect ahead of Anthropic's upcoming IPO
news.summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirde Bosa and Ejaaz Ahamadeen are joined by Jesse Zhang, Decagon Co-Founder and CEO, and Cristóbal Valenzuela, Runway Co-Founder and Co-CEO at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest Conference. The panel discusses market volatility following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, the future of open-weight AI models, and what to expect ahead of Anthropic's upcoming IPO.

news.title: Nvidia's biggest challenge: Replacing Jensen Huang
news.summary: "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the story of the year: Jensen Huang stepping down as Nvidia (NVDA) CEO. The hosts revisit key developments surrounding the leadership shake-up and examine what comes next for the AI chip giant. While Nvidia's operations will continue, the hosts discuss Huang's influence on the company's success and why replacing him as leader could prove challenging.

news.title: Lutnick agrees to testify before Congress as Republicans pile on the embattled Commerce secretary
news.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has reportedly agreed to testify before lawmakers next month as the spotlight on him grows harsher amid Nvidia's turmoil.
